name: O'Fallon (United States)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the city seal in yellow: a ring reading O'FALLON, ILLINOIS FOUNDED 1854 around a quartered disc with a pickaxe, aircraft, a locomotive and a plough.
history: O'Fallon is a city in St. Clair County, Illinois. The flag was adopted in 1975 (the seal designed in 1974 by Michael Donovan in a contest of the O'Fallon Junior Woman's Club was finalised by Louis Bradshaw and adopted as the city flag in May 1975, according to English Wikipedia).
